question: Who is the author of “Confessions of a Shakespeare Addict”?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**V.S. Ravi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Former IPS officer V.S. Ravi launches book celebrating lifelong passion for Shakespeare.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**V.S. Ravi**, a **retired IPS officer**, has **launched his book** titled *“Confessions of a Shakespeare Addict”*.

 
 
• 
 
The event took place in **Hyderabad**.

 
 
• 
 
The launch was attended by **respected officials** and **literature lovers**.

 
 
• 
 
The book explores **V.S. Ravi’s lifelong interest** and **passion for Shakespeare**.

 
 
• 
 
The book was **celebrated** by many who share his admiration for the **works of Shakespeare**.
